reason: The analyst controls for buyer_rating_2023, a post-treatment variable (r=0.49 with diversity), which flips the estimate to a spurious -2.2. With only pre-treatment controls the effect is about 0.05 (SE 0.25, p=0.84), i.e. no effect, so the 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported. The analyst also omitted several pre-period covariates, trimmed the sample, and ran only one specification.
